level.title: Marathi B1+ — Meetings that decide something
goals: Put an item on the agenda and state your opinion without heat
Take a responsibility, report progress, and name an obstacle
Keep the minutes, announce the decision, and review the result

lessons.title: कार्यसूची ठरवणे
lessons.learn: An agenda is कार्यसूची and the items on it are मुद्दे. A meeting opens with अध्यक्ष, moves item by item with हा मुद्दा, and closes with other matters — अन्य विषय. Pinning the agenda uses ठरवणे or मांडणे.

grammar.title: Putting an item on the agenda
grammar.pattern: कार्यसूचीत … मांडतो · हा मुद्दा तिसरा आहे · अन्य विषय
grammar.explain: An item goes on the agenda with मांडणे: कार्यसूचीत हा मुद्दा मांडतो. Items are counted with पहिला, दुसरा (मुद्दा is masculine), and other business is अन्य विषय. The chairperson's role is stated with अध्यक्षता: अध्यक्षता … करतात.

examples.en: The first item on the agenda is yours.
I am putting this item before the meeting.

examples.t: अन्य विषयासाठी शेवटी वेळ ठेवला आहे.
examples.r: Anya vishayasathi shevti vel thevla ahe.
examples.en: Time is kept at the end for other matters.

mistakes.why: A statement of intent takes the simple present here.

dialogue.t: आजची कार्यसूची वाचा.
dialogue.r: Aajchi karyasuchi vaacha.
dialogue.en: Read today's agenda.

dialogue.t: पहिला मुद्दा अंदाजपत्रक, दुसरा मुद्दा वेळापत्रक.
dialogue.r: Pahila mudda andajpatrak, dusra mudda velapatrak.
dialogue.en: The first item is the budget, the second the schedule.

dialogue.t: वेळापत्रकाचा मुद्दा पुढे ढकलू या का?
dialogue.r: Velapatrakacha mudda pudhe dhakalu ya ka?
dialogue.en: Shall we move the schedule item later?

dialogue.t: ठीक, मग तो शेवटी अन्य विषयात घेऊ.
dialogue.r: Thik, mag to shevti anya vishayat gheu.
dialogue.en: All right, then we will take it at the end among other matters.

lessons.title: मत मांडणे आणि आक्षेप
lessons.learn: Opinions open with माझ्या मते or मला वाटते, agreement with सहमत आहे and objection with आक्षेप आहे or हरकत आहे. मत is neuter, हरकत is feminine, and मुद्दा is masculine — agreement follows the noun.

grammar.title: Opinions and objections
grammar.pattern: माझ्या मते · मी सहमत आहे · मला आक्षेप आहे
grammar.explain: माझ्या मते is the neutral opener, मी सहमत आहे agrees, and आक्षेप आहे objects while staying impersonal: the objection is attached to the point, not the person. A suggestion is offered with सूचना देते/देतो, and दुसरे मत is the other view.

examples.en: In my opinion the schedule should be changed.
I have an objection on this point.
I have a suggestion.

mistakes.why: The fixed phrase is माझ्या मते.

dialogue.t: वेळापत्रकाबद्दल प्रत्येकाचे मत सांगा.
dialogue.r: Velapatrakabaddal pratyekache mat sanga.
dialogue.en: Everyone state your opinion about the schedule.

dialogue.t: माझ्या मते काम दोन टप्प्यांत व्हावे.
dialogue.r: Majhya mate kaam don tappyant vhave.
dialogue.en: In my opinion the work should be in two stages.

dialogue.t: मला तत्त्व सहमत आहे, पण दुसऱ्या टप्प्यावर आक्षेप आहे.
dialogue.r: Mala tattva sahmat ahe, pan dusrya tappyavar aakshep ahe.
dialogue.en: I agree in principle, but I object to the second stage.

dialogue.t: ठीक, दुसरा टप्पा आधी तपासून ठरवू.
dialogue.r: Thik, dusra tappa aadhi tapasun tharvu.
dialogue.en: All right, we will decide the second stage after checking.

lessons.title: सारांश आणि ठराव
lessons.learn: A summary is सारांश and a resolution ठराव. समजले/ठरले states what was decided, and the minutes are नोंदी. The resolution takes होणे (ठराव झाला), not करणे.

grammar.title: Summing up
grammar.explain: थोडक्यात opens the summary and ठरले की … closes it. A resolution is झाला (ठराव झाला) and the record is ठेवली (नोंद ठेवली). सारांश is masculine, and the conclusion is stated before the thanks.

examples.en: In short, two stages were decided.
Everyone accepted the resolution.
The secretary keeps the minutes.

dialogue.t: बैठकीचा सारांश द्या.
dialogue.r: Baithkicha saraansh dya.

dialogue.t: थोडक्यात: दोन टप्पे ठरले, दुसऱ्याची तपासणी पुढे.
dialogue.r: Thodakyat: don tappe tharale, dusryachi tapasni pudhe.
dialogue.en: In short: two stages were decided, the second is to be checked later.

dialogue.t: ठराव सर्वांनी मान्य केला का?
dialogue.r: Tharav sarvanni manya kela ka?
dialogue.en: Did everyone accept the resolution?

dialogue.t: हो, एक अनुपस्थित. नोंदी मी ठेवतो.
dialogue.r: Ho, ek anupasthit. Nondi mi thevto.
dialogue.en: Yes, one absent. I keep the minutes.

lessons.title: जबाबदारी आणि मुदत
lessons.learn: Work is divided with वाटणी, responsibility is जबाबदारी (feminine) and a deadline मुदत (feminine). The future takes -ईल/-ईन: ती जबाबदारी घेईल, मी घेईन. A deadline is dated with -पर्यंत and the part still to come is उरलेले काम.

grammar.title: Who does what by when
grammar.pattern: मी ही जबाबदारी घेईन · मुदत शुक्रवारपर्यंत · उरलेले काम
grammar.explain: जबाबदारी घेणे is to take on the work, and it takes the future: घेईन (I), घेईल (he/she), घेतील (they). A deadline ends in -पर्यंत (शुक्रवारपर्यंत), and the part still to come is उरलेले काम.

lessons.title: प्रगती कळवणे
lessons.learn: Progress is reported in three states: झाले आहे (done), सुरू आहे (going on) and उरले आहे (left). प्रगती is feminine, झाले/सुरू are participles, and the totals take the neuter.

grammar.title: Reporting progress

lessons.title: अडचण आणि मदत
lessons.learn: An obstacle is अडचण or अडथळा, and it आली (came) rather than झाली. Help is asked for with मदत लागेल, and extra hands are माणसे or सहकार्य.

grammar.title: Naming the obstacle
grammar.pattern: अडचण आली · मदत लागेल · माणसे लागतील
grammar.explain: अडचण and अडथळा arrive: आली, आला. What is needed takes लागणे — मदत लागेल, माणसे लागतील — and the request is softened with -ता तर: शक्य झाले तर दोन माणसे द्या.

lessons.learn: The minutes are नोंदी and the follow-up पाठपुरावा (masculine). नोंद ठेवणे keeps a record and पाठपुरावा करणे chases it, but the work done goes with अमलात आणणे.

grammar.title: Following up
grammar.pattern: नोंदी ठेवा · पाठपुरावा करा · वेळेवर अमलात आणा
grammar.explain: नोंदी ठेवणे keeps the record and पाठपुरावा करणे asks about it afterwards: पाठपुरावा करतो. A promise is वचन and keeping it is वचन पाळणे; putting a decision into effect is अमलात आणणे.

examples.en: Keep the minutes of the meeting.
I will follow up next week.
Put the decision into effect on time.

dialogue.r: Nondi tayar aahet ka?
dialogue.en: Are the minutes ready?

dialogue.t: तयार आहेत. सहा निर्णय आणि दोन वचने नोंदवली आहेत.
dialogue.r: Tayar aahet. Saha nirnay aani don vachne nondavli aahet.
dialogue.en: They are ready. Six decisions and two undertakings are recorded.

dialogue.t: पाठपुरावा कोण करेल?
dialogue.r: Paathpurava kon karel?
dialogue.en: Who will follow up?

dialogue.t: मी. सोमवारी प्रत्येकाला विचारतो आणि अहवाल देतो.
dialogue.r: Mi. Somvari pratyekala vichaarto aani ahaval deto.
dialogue.en: I will. On Monday I will ask each one and give a report.

lessons.title: निर्णय कळवणे
lessons.learn: A decision goes out in the impersonal passive: कळवले जाईल, ठरवले जाईल. जाईल takes the neuter participle, and the notice is सूचना, the board फलक.

grammar.title: Announcing a decision
grammar.pattern: निर्णय कळवले जाईल · फलकावर लावा · सर्वांना जाहीर करा
grammar.explain: The impersonal -ले जाईल removes the person from the announcement: कळवले जाईल, ठरवले जाईल, लावले जाईल. The notice goes on the फलक (फलकावर लावा) and the announcement is जाहीर करणे.

examples.en: The decision will be announced tomorrow.

examples.t: पुढची बैठक पंधरा दिवसांनी ठरवली जाईल.
examples.r: Pudchi baithak pandhra divsanni tharvli jail.
examples.en: The next meeting will be fixed after fifteen days.
Put the notice on the board.

mistakes.why: The passive takes the neuter: कळवले जाईल.

dialogue.en: When will the decision be known outside?

dialogue.en: It will be announced this evening.

dialogue.t: सूचना फलकावर लावायची का?
dialogue.r: Suchana phalkavar lavaychi ka?
dialogue.en: Is the notice to be put on the board?

dialogue.t: हो, आणि सर्व खात्यांना जाहीर करा.
dialogue.r: Ho, aani sarv khatyanna jaahir kara.
dialogue.en: Yes, and announce it to all departments.

lessons.title: आढावा बैठक
lessons.learn: A review is आढावा (masculine) and it is घेतला. Expectations are अपेक्षा (feminine) with अपेक्षेपेक्षा for more than expected, and a change for the better is सुधारणा.

grammar.title: Reviewing the result
grammar.pattern: अपेक्षेपेक्षा जास्त · सुधारणा झाली · उशीर झाला
grammar.explain: अपेक्षेपेक्षा is more than expected and अपेक्षेइतके is as much as expected. सुधारणा and वाढ take झाली, while उशीर takes झाला. A review is घेतला (आढावा घेतला), never केला.

examples.t: या महिन्यात अपेक्षेपेक्षा जास्त काम झाले.
examples.r: Ya mahinyat apekshepeksha jaast kaam jhale.
examples.en: This month more work was done than expected.
Give the reason for the delay.
There will be an improvement next month.

mistakes.why: A review is घेतला: आढावा घेतला.

dialogue.t: मागच्या महिन्याचा आढावा घ्या.
dialogue.r: Maagchya mahinyacha aadhava ghya.
dialogue.en: Review last month's work.

dialogue.t: अपेक्षेपेक्षा जास्त काम झाले, पण दोन ठिकाणी उशीर झाला.
dialogue.r: Apekshepeksha jaast kaam jhale, pan don thikani ushir jhala.
dialogue.en: More work was done than expected, but there were delays in two places.

dialogue.t: कारण काय?
dialogue.r: Karan kay?
dialogue.en: What is the reason?

dialogue.t: आकडे उशिरा मिळाले. पुढच्या महिन्यात निकष बदलू.
dialogue.r: Aakde ushira milale. Pudchya mahinyat nikash badlu.
dialogue.en: The figures came late. Next month we will change the standard.

culture.text: Every year after the monsoon, lakhs of Warkaris walk to Pandharpur in the वारी — some three weeks on the road, in palkhis that carry the padukas of Dnyaneshwar and Tukaram. The walkers sing abhangas in Marathi, and the whole road becomes a moving library of the language: चालवा, टाळ, मृदंग, and verse after verse on Vitthal. For a learner this is Marathi at its oldest and most public — heard in the fields, not in a classroom.

reading.text: बैठक आटोपल्यावर सचिवाने नोंदी लगेच लिहिल्या. सहा निर्णय आणि दोन वचने नोंदवली गेली. पुढच्या आठवड्यात प्रत्येक जबाबदारीचा पाठपुरावा करायचा होता, म्हणून त्याने कामाची वाटणी केली. दोन सदस्यांनी मुदत वेळेवर पाळली, पण एका ठिकाणी आकडे उशिरा मिळाल्यामुळे अडचण आली. सचिवाने अध्यक्षांना कळवले आणि मदत मागितली. अध्यक्षांनी दोन माणसे दिली. महिन्याच्या शेवटी आढावा बैठकीत अपेक्षेपेक्षा जास्त काम झाल्याचे दिसले.
reading.gloss: After the meeting ended, the secretary wrote the minutes at once. Six decisions and two undertakings were recorded. The following week each responsibility had to be followed up, so he divided the work. Two members kept their deadlines on time, but at one place a difficulty came up because the figures arrived late. The secretary informed the chairperson and asked for help. The chairperson gave two people. At the end of the month, the review meeting showed that more work had been done than expected.

task.title: Run a meeting on paper, in Marathi
task.instructions: Write a Marathi exchange of eight to ten turns: agree on an agenda with three items, state one opinion with माझ्या मते, raise one objection, summarise with थोडक्यात, fix one responsibility with a deadline, and announce the decision in the impersonal passive (कळवले जाईल). Then write three lines of minutes using नोंद ठेवली and ठरले.
